test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
n this question, a statement is given followed by two courses of action numbered I and II. You must assume everything in the statement to be true, and based on the information given in the statement, decide which of the given courses of action logically follows the statement.

**Statement:**

Some major cities may see the highest temperatures in nearly 100 years during Christmas, while others may require a whole new Christmas record book. According to experts, this is partly related to global warming.

**Courses:**

I. Citizens should be advised to follow measures to combat global warming.

II. Solar energy should be used as a renewable source of energy.

options.text: Only course of action II follows.
Neither course of action I nor course of action II follows.
Only course of action I follows.
Both courses of action I and II follow.

solution:
The first course of action follows because the global warming is identified as the cause; it is logical to advise citizens to take preventive or corrective measures.

The first course of action follows because using solar energy reduces dependency on fossil fuels—one of the main contributors to global warming.

Both courses of action I and II follow.

Hence, "option 4" is the correct answer.
